ESET-001.note: PREFERENCES-POLICY documents native metadata, bounded validation, scope, privacy, missing-marker migration and ledger links for the current model. The full ledger and approved shared semantics remain Required; this foundation does not activate the package.

ESET-002.note: Production loading distinguishes missing, valid, invalid, unknown and newer-version fields, repairs known invalid values independently and records value-free diagnostics. The winning native instance loads before opening editors and presents field recovery/read-only fallback through native warnings. Native host tests preserve unrelated/unknown values after recovery and a recent-list save. Remaining fields and complete recovery qualification remain Required. Window dimensions and memory/maximized flags now recover independently with field-specific native diagnostic labels.

ESET-003.note: Production QSaveFile replacement stores current and privacy-pruned previous values as one artifact, preserves compatible unknown fields, enforces private bounded storage and rejects stale/locked writes. Injected failure and real-file tests prove unchanged stored versions and published state. Approved retention policy, independent recovery from a destroyed whole file, computed/convenience exclusions and all fields remain Required. BorderColor/FillColor convenience aliases are now explicitly non-persistent; the rest of the ledger exclusions remain Required. AccentColor is also explicitly non-persistent.

ESET-004.note: Qt Core appearance policy resolves validated theme/system-theme and accent/system-accent preferences against translated desktop hints and a native palette. Saved alpha is retained while display roles are composited and adjusted for text/highlight contrast; high-contrast and reduced-motion hints remain independent of persisted values. Independent analytical, precedence, invalid-hint, per-field recovery and round-trip tests cover this foundation. Native desktop observation/controls, physical theme/focus/assistive-technology evidence and shared semantic/compatibility qualification remain Required.

ESET-005.note: Production Qt Core fields and placement constrain normal client/frame bounds to usable logical work areas, greatest overlap or preferred fallback. Native controller observes Qt screen/work-area/DPI/window-state changes, preserves normal size and maximized state while minimized, and recovers normal placement without writing. Actual accepted close saves only after Save/Discard/Cancel succeeds; cancelled/reentrant closes and failed image saves do not capture state. Shared memory toggle saves before publishing, rolls back failed toggles and removes bounds/maximized state plus memory authority from current/previous versions when disabled. Core analytical, native injected-display, actual editor-frame/history/file, maximize/minimize, restart, cancellation and locked-write tests cover the implementation. Physical compositor/display/scaling, accessibility and shared default/metadata/compatibility qualification remain Required.

ESET-006.note: Persisted border/fill/thickness now initialize new/replaced native sessions and update creation defaults in all open editors only after successful persistence. Apply/Cancel and reset are draft operations; existing/selected annotations, source, checkpoint and undo/redo remain unchanged. Actual toolbar color/width edits keep explicit selection history and persist subsequent creation defaults; a failed preference save leaves the document edit intact with a persistent status diagnostic. Core/native multi-window, picker, sidecar, restart and redo tests cover this subset. Last tool and all remaining creation defaults remain Required.

ESET-007.note: BorderColorHex/FillColorHex load and persist uppercase alpha-preserving #AARRGGBB; compatible opaque #RRGGBB receives FF alpha. Invalid values recover per field with visible value-free diagnostics. Derived BorderColor/FillColor aliases are non-persistent and cannot override canonical fields; unknown color extensions survive. Native defaults and actual toolbar color pickers preserve alpha, reject malformed drafts atomically and persist through restart/sidecar saves. Other color fields and full shared metadata review remain Required. AccentColorHex now shares canonical alpha-preserving validation and computed-alias exclusion with independent core round-trip/recovery evidence; native appearance integration remains Required.

ESET-008.note: Native font validation, fallback without implicit rewrite and text/step preferences remain Required.

ESET-009.note: Production blur/thickness/recent-limit validation rejects invalid types, fractional integers and non-finite or out-of-range numbers. Native thickness controls share the inclusive 1..10000 range; color/style Apply validates all fields before saving. Independent core boundaries and native rejection tests cover this subset. All other numeric effect fields and full UI/import/automation parity remain Required.

ESET-010.note: Persistent toolbar action placements and protected hotkey validation remain Required.

ESET-011.note: Native toolbar customization and atomic persistence remain Required.

ESET-012.note: Native editor/tray opt-in and bounded newest-first path management now persist in isolated private versioned storage. Apply writes before publishing; Cancel, failed writes and stale modal drafts preserve active/stored values. Remove, Clear, trim and opt-out prune forgotten paths from current and retained previous versions together. Actual Open/complete Save record paths, incomplete saves do not, and preference-save failures visibly survive focus/document refresh without undoing successful image work. Native restart/removal/locking/unknown-field/privacy tests pass; approved retention policy and human privacy/security/compatibility qualification remain Required.

ESET-013.note: Stable persistent recent/favorite effect lists and retired-ID handling remain Required.

ESET-014.note: Persistent automation/convenience preferences with consent and error invariants remain Required.

ESET-015.note: All three published operations call production code. Independent core and real native-control tests cover current field boundaries, missing markers, newer/unreadable preservation, unknown round-trip, atomic failures, private files, privacy-pruned recovery, restart, Apply/Cancel, capped stale revisions and actual image Open/Save. Every remaining field, supported upgrades, all other platform adapters and acceptance reviews remain Required. Drawing-default tests now add canonical alpha, non-persistent aliases, invalid/cancelled/reset/locked/stale drafts, actual color pickers, multi-window creation-only effects, preserved redo, session replacement and PNG/sidecar/restart evidence. Window boundary, type, independent geometry and disabled-memory recovery tests cover the production core; native port, actual editor lifecycle/display recovery, memory toggles, cancellation, failure, restart and preserved source/checkpoint/redo evidence are now present. Physical display and acceptance review remain Required.

ESET-016.note: Existing native editor actions, modal and text-entry precedence have native tests. Complete shortcut catalog and persistent custom-hotkey collision validation remain Required.
